description: Use when you need a news briefing, a research summary of recent coverage or an analysis of what the press says about a topic or company. Do not use for breaking news, paywalled pages or one known article (use blackwood_webpage_markdown). Returns JSON with a research briefing on a topic in one call: up to 3 recent GDELT news articles, each read and summarized, with source and link, below the price of separate calls for 0.04 USDC per call. Typical response time 15000 ms (p95). Category: Search.

hours.description: How far back to look for news, in hours, 1 to 72 (24 when omitted), e.g. 48

language.description: Language of the summaries (English when omitted), e.g. Portuguese

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

topic.description: Topic, company or person to research, e.g. stablecoin regulation

name: blackwood_news_briefing

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: News research briefing
